label: Research presentation or exposition
definition: The item presents original research or an expository account of a topic.

label: Interpretation and analysis
definition: The item interprets or analyzes an existing text/problem without new primary research.
examples: a close reading of a verse

label: Identification or textual help
definition: A request for or provision of help identifying a text/term/passage.
inclusion: "What text is this quote from?" threads.

label: Bibliographic request
definition: A request for or provision of reading/reference recommendations.
inclusion: "Where can I find secondary literature on X?"
exclusion: Resource sharing without a request (see resource_sharing).
examples: asking for a bibliography on a topic

label: Resource sharing
inclusion: Posting a PDF; sharing a corpus link.
exclusion: A reply answering a bibliographic request.

label: Teaching and learning
definition: Pedagogical exchange between teacher and learner.
inclusion: Classroom questions; course announcements about content.
examples: asking how to parse a compound

label: Scholarly debate
definition: Substantive disagreement between scholars on a scholarly point.
examples: a dispute over a dating hypothesis

label: Publication announcement or review
definition: Announcing or reviewing a new publication.

label: Jobs, grants, or training
inclusion: Job postings; grant calls; fellowship announcements.

label: Commemoration or obituary
definition: Memorial or biographical tribute to a person.
exclusion: Ordinary biographical research (see institutions_field_history in intellectual_content).

label: Social/ritual exchange
exclusion: Substantive content of any other kind.

label: Other
definition: A recognizable community function not covered by the above.
inclusion: Any coherent function outside the other labels.
exclusion: Anything that instead fits an existing label; structural records that perform no function in the medium (see not_applicable); unreadable items (see unknown).

label: Unknown
definition: Insufficient evidence to assign a function; the item surely performed one.
exclusion: Items where a function could be determined; structural records outside the medium's discourse (see not_applicable).

label: Not applicable
definition: The record is a structural or container artifact that performs no communicative function in the medium itself, so no function label can apply.
inclusion: Synthetic container/event records; placeholder records for unavailable sources.
exclusion: Any real message/post/presentation (every one of those performs some function, even if unknown); unreadable items (see unknown).
examples: a placeholder record for an unavailable source
